reviews.comment: Lectures were a bit more theoretical and could have been better if he included more examples. Exams were very similar to the homework so if you can do the homework well, you should have no problem on the exams. Very willing to answer questions in class. Wish the exam questions were a bit more independent, as one wrong could affect future answers

This professor was absolutely subpar. His lectures had zero correlation with the homework and the homework had no real answer key. If you miss one question on an exam, then it causes a chain reaction and makes you miss the next few as well that follow it. He changed the grade cutoff last second so I received a sneaky B. Absolute scam.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor didn't teach. TA office hours were much more helpful than class itself. Homework was on Webassign and counts for 40% of the grade, but you only get 2 tries per question. So entering two wrong answers on a Webassign question could equate to 0.5% of your ENTIRE class grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Yang Ni is an AMAZING professor. Makes course material accessible and digestible. He is well-spoken, cares immensely for students , and is always prepared to answer any questions that come his way. Would absolutely take another class from him again!

I would take another of his classes in a heartbeat. He teaches with a LOT of care. And encourages students to ask questions and explains them in details. So I learned a lot. Add to that, he is quite liberal with grades so that was icing on the cake. He is a great and approachable person. Highly recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures
